payload.core_mechanism_summary: Increment k from 2, compute divisor 2^k-1, check if n divisible, output n/(2^k-1) when found.
payload.rationale: The code exhaustively tries successive k values, a simple search without backtracking, but other candidates (bitmask, B&B, graph, permutation) are clearly unrelated; search_backtracking is the only plausible match.
